content: Hi! How can I help you today? Are you looking to organize or share your school event photos?
Hi! Yes, I'd like to share the class play photos with the other parents, but I want to make sure everyone's privacy is respected.
That's wonderful, and thoughtful of you! I recommend uploading your photos to a private folder and sharing a view-only link. Would you like a template for organizing by event date and group?
Yes, please. I have pictures from both the rehearsal and the day of the play. Should I separate those?
Great question! Creating two folders, one for rehearsal and one for performance, makes browsing easy for everyone. You can use names like '2024-05-28_Play_Rehearsal' and '2024-05-29_Performance.'
Perfect. I'll do that. Should I ask for consent before sharing photos with other parents?
Absolutely, that's best practice. Before uploading, double-check if any parents prefer not to have their child's photo shared, and only include photos with everyone's consent.
That makes sense. Once I have consent, do I just send the link to the folders?

Exactly! After uploading, copy the view-only folder links and send them to the group. Encourage parents to click and browse the albums, and let them know they can download any photos they'd like to keep.
Should I add anything to help them find specific moments?

Labeling photos by scene or group is a nice touch. You can even include a simple index file, here's a template: <template_index_link>. This helps everyone quickly find their children's special moments.
Thanks! Is there a way to make sure the files don't get lost over time?

Great thinking! Keep a backup folder in your own drive and, if you want extra safety, download a ZIP archive of all originals. For extra peace of mind, you can save a file inventory with basic names and counts.
I'll follow your advice. I appreciate how easy you've made this.
I'm glad to help! Once your folders are ready, share the links and invite everyone to click, browse, and download their favorites. Let me know if you need help with anything else.
